verdict.rationale: cubic documents auto-resolving review threads when an issue is fixed, which covers the 'tracks what was fixed' part of the story. 'Every review of a pull request' implies a PR can be reviewed more than once. Nothing documents that a new push automatically triggers an incremental re-review limited to the new commits, or that old comments are not repeated. Missing for 10: documented push-triggered re-review, incremental diff-only scope, explicit suppression of duplicate comments, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review that tracks what was fixed instead of repeating old comments

citations.quote: Auto-resolve threads: Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
